question: Should OpenClaw adopt the RFC’s shared localization and presentation-metadata contract across Gateway, plugin/skill metadata, CLI/TUI, and channel surfaces as this ordered foundation series proposes?
rationale: This is a new cross-product contract with compatibility-sensitive Gateway and presentation metadata, while the referenced RFC remains open and the current branch is cumulative rather than an independently mergeable product-surface change.

options.title: Sponsor the staged contract
options.body: Approve the RFC direction, require the foundation PRs to land in order, and review a rebased product-surfaces slice with upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep localization owner-local and remove or defer the shared Gateway and plugin/skill metadata surfaces until a smaller contract is agreed.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Leave the drafts open but do not merge the localization architecture until an owner confirms the permanent product boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged contract
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC direction, require the foundation PRs to land in order, and review a rebased product-surfaces slice with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the RFC-linked localization series, though an authorized OpenClaw owner must make the product decision.
